dialog.english:
��������I've always worried about
T.K...
dialog.translation:
Siempre me he preocupado por
T.K...

dialog.english:
I thought, "If I'm not there,
T.K can't do anything."
dialog.translation:
Pensaba: "Si yo no estoy ahí,
T.K no puede hacer nada."

dialog.english:
But before I'd realized it, T.K
had grown up. He doesn't need me
anymore.
dialog.translation:
Pero sin darme cuenta, T.K
ha crecido. Ya no me necesita.

dialog.english: Matt...
dialog.translation: Matt...

dialog.english:
Not just T.K. Tai and Sora
and Mimi and Joe and Izzy...
dialog.translation:
No solo T.K. Tai, Sora,
Mimi, Joe, Izzy...

dialog.english:
Everyone's changed... but I'm the
same as ever!
dialog.translation:
Todos cambiaron, y yo sigo
igual que siempre!

dialog.english: That's not true, Matt. You've...
dialog.translation:
Eso no es verdad, Matt. Tú
has...

dialog.english:
So what am I supposed to be? Am I
supposed to just stay like this?
dialog.translation:
Entonces qué se supone que sea?
Me quedo así para siempre?

dialog.english: Matt...
dialog.translation: Matt...

dialog.english:
I can't stay like this... I have
to get stronger!
dialog.translation:
No puedo seguir así... debo
hacerme más fuerte!

dialog.english: Oh ho ho.
dialog.translation: Ju ju ju.

dialog.english: Who's there?!
dialog.translation: Quién anda?!

dialog.english: I am Jureimon.
dialog.translation: Soy Jureimon.

dialog.english: Jureimon?!
dialog.translation: Jureimon?!

dialog.english:
You're with Pinocchimon, aren't
you?
dialog.translation: Vas con Puppetmon, verdad?

dialog.english: Oh, wait right there.
dialog.translation: Espera ahí quieto.

dialog.english: Shut up!
dialog.translation: Cállate!

dialog.english:
Hold on. I'm not exactly here to
fight you. Oh ho ho.
dialog.translation:
Espera. No vengo a luchar
contigo. Ju, ju, ju.

dialog.english:
Then I don't have any business
with you!
dialog.translation:
Entonces no tengo nada que
ver contigo!

dialog.english:
That's not how you should be
treating your elders! Oh ho ho.
dialog.translation:
Así no se trata a los mayores!
Ju, ju, ju.

dialog.english:
"What am I supposed to be? Am I
supposed to just stay like this?"
dialog.translation:
"Qué se supone que sea? Me
quedo así para siempre?"

dialog.english:
It's important to sit down and
take a long look into yourself.
dialog.translation:
Es importante sentarse y
mirar bien dentro de uno mismo.

dialog.english: Were you listening to that?
dialog.translation: Estabas escuchando eso?

dialog.english:
It doesn't matter whether or not I
was. There's nothing that I don't
know.
dialog.translation:
Da igual si lo escuché o no.
No hay nada que yo no sepa.

dialog.english:
Then tell me! What am I supposed
to do?
dialog.translation:
Pues dímelo! Qué se supone
que haga?

dialog.english:
Are you sure you want to know? If
you want to become stronger, you
must improve yourself.
dialog.translation:
Seguro que quieres saberlo? Si
quieres ser más fuerte, debes
mejorar tú mismo.

dialog.english: Improve myself...?
dialog.translation: Mejorar yo mismo?

dialog.english:
Yes... but you have to have
resolve.
dialog.translation:
Sí... pero hace falta
decisión.

dialog.english:
I... I have resolve. So tell me!
What should I do?
dialog.translation:
Yo... tengo decisión. Dímelo!
Qué debo hacer?

dialog.english: What should I do?
dialog.translation: Qué debo hacer?

dialog.english: You must defeat your rival.
dialog.translation: Debes vencer a tu rival.

dialog.english: My rival?
dialog.translation: Mi rival?

dialog.english:
Tai's my rival...? Hahaha! I've
never thought of him that way, not
even once!
dialog.translation:
Tai, mi rival...? Jajaja! Nunca
lo he visto así, ni una sola
vez!

dialog.english:
But I know. Everything that Tai
says or does...
dialog.translation:
Pero yo sé. Todo lo que Tai
dice o hace...

dialog.english:
You always let it bother you...
That's how much of an impact he
has on you.
dialog.translation:
Siempre dejas que te afecte...
Eso es lo mucho que él influye
en ti.

dialog.english:
As long as you can't overcome
those thoughts, you can't become 
greater than you are now.
dialog.translation:
Mientras no superes esos
pensamientos, no puedes llegar
a más de lo que eres ahora.

dialog.english:
Fight Tai. Shake off your
uncertain heart and be reborn!
dialog.translation:
Lucha contra Tai. Sacúdete
esa duda y renace!

dialog.english:
Lies! Don't believe any of that
trash! Tai's your friend, isn't
he? Don't be fooled!
dialog.translation:
Mentiras! No te creas esa
basura! Tai es tu amigo, no?
No te dejes engañar!

dialog.english:
Y-Yeah... we're friends! You
seriously think I'm gonna fight my
own friend?
dialog.translation:
S-sí... somos amigos! De
verdad crees que voy a luchar
contra mi amigo?

dialog.english:
Oh, he's your friend? You don't
seem to truly believe that. You
shouldn't lie to yourself.
dialog.translation:
Ah, es tu amigo? No pareces
creértelo del todo. No deberías
engañarte a ti mismo.

dialog.english: No way...
dialog.translation: Qué va...

dialog.english:
Camraderie, friends, friendship...
all of those are fantasies. Am I
wrong, Matt?
dialog.translation:
Compañerismo, amigos, amistad...
todo eso son fantasías. Me
equivoco, Matt?

dialog.english: I... I don't know!
dialog.translation: Yo... yo no lo sé!

dialog.english:
Get it? Go fight Tai if you
want to improve yourself.
dialog.translation:
Lo entiendes? Ve a luchar
contra Tai si quieres mejorar.

dialog.english:
If you don't have resolve, you
won't be able to change!
dialog.translation:
Si no tienes decisión, nunca
podrás cambiar!

dialog.english: I don't know! What should I do...
dialog.translation:
No lo sé! Qué debería
hacer...

dialog.english:
Why is my Crest the Crest of
Friendship?
dialog.translation:
Por qué mi Emblema es el
de la Amistad?

dialog.english:
Matt...Okay, Matt. If that's
what you really think, I'll go
along with you.
dialog.translation:
Matt... Vale, Matt. Si de
verdad piensas eso, iré
contigo.

dialog.english: Gabumon...
dialog.translation: Gabumon...

dialog.english:
Tai's way of constantly rushing
into things isn't always
necessarily the right thing to do.
dialog.translation:
La forma de Tai de lanzarse
siempre de cabeza no siempre
es lo correcto.

dialog.english:
There must be something that only
you can do, Matt.
dialog.translation:
Debe de haber algo que solo
tú puedas hacer, Matt.

dialog.english: Something only I can do...
dialog.translation: Algo que solo yo haga...

dialog.english:
We'll find it together! And if the
only way to do that is to fight
for you...
dialog.translation:
Lo encontraremos juntos! Y si
la única forma es luchar por
ti...

dialog.english: Then that's exactly what I'll do!
dialog.translation: Eso es justo lo que haré!

dialog.english: Gabumon...
dialog.translation: Gabumon...

dialog.english:
Even if everyone else becomes your
enemy, Matt, I'll stay with you!
dialog.translation:
Aunque todos se vuelvan tus
enemigos, Matt, seguiré
contigo!

dialog.english: Gabumon!
dialog.translation: Gabumon!

dialog.english: Let's go, Matt!
dialog.translation: Vamos, Matt!

dialog.english: Yeah!
dialog.translation: Vale!

dialog.english:
Lord Pinocchimon... my strategy
has succeeded.
dialog.translation:
Señor Puppetmon... mi
plan ha funcionado.

dialog.english: Hmmm? What kind of strategy is it?
dialog.translation:
Mm? Qué clase de estrategia
es?

dialog.english:
A strategy to make the two
Ultimates, WarGreymon and
MetalGarurumon, fight each other.
dialog.translation:
Un plan para que WarGreymon
y MetalGarurumon, los Cuerpo
Supremo, luchen entre sí.

dialog.english:
Huh, interesting! I've gotta
hurry, or else I'll miss it!
dialog.translation:
Vaya, interesante! Debo
darme prisa o me lo perderé!

dialog.english: Be wary of the Chosen Children!
dialog.translation:
Cuidado con los Niños
Elegidos!

dialog.english:
If you underestimate them, even
you might lose, Lord Pinocchimon.
dialog.translation:
Si los subestimas, hasta tú
podrías perder, Señor Puppetmon.

dialog.english: You're saying I might lose?
dialog.translation: Dices que podría perder?

dialog.english:
They have something you're
missing, Lord Pinocchimon...
dialog.translation:
Ellos tienen algo que a
usted le falta, Puppetmon...

dialog.english:
I'm missing something? You're
saying *I'm* the one missing
something?
dialog.translation:
Que a mí me falta algo? Dices
que soy yo quien tiene algo
que falta?

dialog.english: Yes. That would be...
dialog.translation: Sí. Eso sería...

dialog.english: I'm not missing anything at all!
dialog.translation:
A mí no me falta nada de
nada!

dialog.english: Gaaaaaaaaah!
dialog.translation: Aaaaaaaargh!

dialog.english:
Hmph! I won't forgive anyone who
tries to make a fool of me.
dialog.translation:
Já! No perdono a quien
intenta dejarme en ridículo.

dialog.english: Heeeeeey, Matt!
dialog.translation: Eeeeeeh, Matt!

dialog.english: Mattooooo!
dialog.translation: Maaaaatt!

dialog.english:
Tai... What happened with
Matt?
dialog.translation: Tai... qué le pasó a Matt?

dialog.english:
Like I'd know! Seriously, what's
up with him?
dialog.translation:
Y yo qué sé! En serio, qué
le pasa a ese?

dialog.english: What's wrong, Kari?
dialog.translation: Qué te pasa, Kari?

dialog.english: I heard a voice again.
dialog.translation: Volví a oír una voz.

dialog.english: A voice? Matt's voice?
dialog.translation: Una voz? La voz de Matt?

dialog.english: No... it wasn't Matt's voice.
dialog.translation: No... no era la voz de Matt.

dialog.english: Kari...
dialog.translation: Kari...

dialog.english:
We can't find him. Let's take a
little break.
dialog.translation:
No lo encontramos. Vamos
a descansar un poco.

dialog.english: Geez, where'd Matt go...
dialog.translation: Vaya, dónde estará Matt...

dialog.english: Guys, let's take a little break.
dialog.translation:
Chicos, descansemos un
poco.

dialog.english: It's the Chosen Children!
dialog.translation: Son los Niños Elegidos!

dialog.english: Who's this?
dialog.translation: Quién es?

dialog.english: Take that!
dialog.translation: Toma ya!

dialog.english: Gyaaaaaah!
dialog.translation: Aaaaaaah!

dialog.english: Matt!
dialog.translation: Matt!

dialog.english:
Matt! We've all been wondering
where you went!
dialog.translation:
Matt! Nos tenías a todos
preocupados por ti!

dialog.english: Gabumon!
dialog.translation: Gabumon!

dialog.english: W-Why...
dialog.translation: Por qué?

dialog.english:
Agumon, I challenge you! Evolve to
Ultimate, now!
dialog.translation:
Agumon, te reto! Evoluciona
a Cuerpo Supremo, ya!

dialog.english: No! Why do I have to fight you?
dialog.translation:
No! Por qué luchar
contigo?

dialog.english: What happened to you, Matt?
dialog.translation: Qué te ha pasado, Matt?

dialog.english:
Hey, Matt! Hurry up and stop
him!
dialog.translation:
Oye, Matt! Date prisa y
páralo!

dialog.english:
No... I refuse. Now, hurry up and
evolve to WarGreymon!
dialog.translation:
No... me niego. Evoluciona
a WarGreymon, ya!

dialog.english: You're serious about this.
dialog.translation: Vaya, va en serio.

dialog.english:
Stop joking around! Aren't we your
fellow Chosen Children?
dialog.translation:
Deja de bromear! No somos
tus compañeros Niños Elegidos?

dialog.english:
"Fellow"? Okay, so who's the one
who chose us?
dialog.translation:
"Compañeros"? Y quién nos
eligió, entonces?

dialog.english: Well...
dialog.translation: Pues...

dialog.english:
If you don't know, then why are
you saying I'm one of you?
dialog.translation:
Si no lo sabes, por qué
dices que soy uno de vosotros?

dialog.english:
Don't bother trying to convince
him, Joe. He's being stubborn.
dialog.translation:
No pierdas el tiempo
convenciéndolo, Joe. Está
en sus trece.

dialog.english: Stop this, both of you!
dialog.translation: Parad los dos!

dialog.english:
Don't tell that to *me*! Matt's
the one who's lashing out.
dialog.translation:
Eso no me lo digas a mí!
Matt es el que está atacando.

dialog.english: Whatever, just fight me!
dialog.translation: Da igual, lucha ya!

dialog.english: You're real persistent, Matt.
dialog.translation: Eres muy pesado, Matt.

dialog.english: Tai! Get down!
dialog.translation: Tai! Agáchate!

dialog.english:
Stop it! There's no reason for us
to be fighting!
dialog.translation:
Parad! No hay ninguna razón
para que luchemos!

dialog.english:
Maybe you don't have one, but I
do!
dialog.translation:
Tú no tendrás una, pero yo
sí!

dialog.english: Feel up to fighting now? Ugh!
dialog.translation: Ya quieres luchar? Ugh!

dialog.english: Wanna know why I just hit you?
dialog.translation:
Sabes por qué te he
golpeado?

dialog.english: Yeah, you wanna fight, don't you?
dialog.translation:
Sí, tú quieres pelea,
verdad?

dialog.english: Both of you, stop it!
dialog.translation: Parad los dos!

dialog.english:
This punch isn't from me. It's
from everyone who died for us!
dialog.translation:
Este golpe no es mío. Es de
los que murieron por
nosotros!

dialog.english:
Matt... do you think they'd want
us to be fighting for no reason
like this?
dialog.translation:
Matt... crees que ellos
querrían vernos luchar sin
razón, así?

dialog.english: I don't know!
dialog.translation: No lo sé!

dialog.english: Stooooop! Matt, fighting is bad!
dialog.translation:
Paraaad! Matt, pelear
está mal!

dialog.english: I can't take this anymore!
dialog.translation: No puedo soportarlo más!

dialog.english: Mimi!
dialog.translation: Mimi!

dialog.english:
We fight and we fight, and what do
we get out of it?! I've had
enough!
dialog.translation:
Luchamos y luchamos, y qué
sacamos de eso?! Ya he tenido
bastante!

dialog.english:
Are you our enemies? Or our
friends?
dialog.translation:
Sois enemigos o amigos
nuestros?

dialog.english: Whom is Kari talking to?
dialog.translation: Con quién habla Kari?

dialog.english: I don't know.
dialog.translation: No lo sé.

dialog.english:
I see. So you're not our
enemies...
dialog.translation:
Ya veo. No sois nuestros
enemigos.

dialog.english: Aaaah!
dialog.translation: Aaaah!

dialog.english: Aaaaaaah!
dialog.translation: Aaaaaaah!

dialog.english: Izzy!
dialog.translation: Izzy!

dialog.english: W-What's going on?!
dialog.translation: Q-qué está pasando?

dialog.english: Where are we?
dialog.translation: Dónde estamos

dialog.english: What just happened?
dialog.translation: Qué acaba de pasar?

dialog.english:
I am one who wishes for stability
in the Digital World.
dialog.translation:
Soy quien desea estabilidad
para el Digimundo.

dialog.english: What are you saying, Kari...?
dialog.translation: Qué estás diciendo, Kari...?

dialog.english: Kari's not the one talking.
dialog.translation: Kari no es quien habla.

dialog.english:
Someone's using Kari's mouth to
speak to us.
dialog.translation:
Alguien usa la boca de Kari
para hablarnos.

dialog.english:
We prepared eight DigiEggs for the
time when the world would be
covered by the powers of darkness.
dialog.translation:
Preparamos ocho DigiHuevos
para cuando el mundo quedara
cubierto por la oscuridad.

dialog.english:
First, from your data, we created
the Digivices and the Emblemas.
dialog.translation:
Primero, con vuestros datos
creamos Digivices y Emblemas.

dialog.english:
Which means you're the ones who
chose us?
dialog.translation:
Entonces vosotros nos
elegisteis?

dialog.english:
Yes. Four years ago, when you met
the Digimon for the first time in
Karigaoka...
dialog.translation:
Sí. Hace cuatro años, cuando
conocisteis a los Digimon en
Hikarioka...

dialog.english:
The light around you all was there
to scan your data.
dialog.translation:
La luz os rodeaba para
escanear vuestros datos.

dialog.english: And you chose us...
dialog.translation: Y nos elegisteis...

dialog.english:
The Digivices and Emblemas are there 
to properly evolve your Digimon in 
accordance with your natures.
dialog.translation:
Los Digivices y Emblemas están
para que vuestros Digimon
evolucionen a su manera.

dialog.english:
So... when I made Agumon evolve into
SkullGreymon...
dialog.translation:
Cuando hice evolucionar a
Agumon a SkullGreymon...

dialog.english:
It was because I had the wrong
kind of courage.
dialog.translation:
Fue porque tenía el tipo
de valor equivocado.

dialog.english: Yes. You've finally realized.
dialog.translation:
Por fin te has dado
cuenta.

dialog.english:
We've been struggling, trying to
find things about ourselves that
we had in the first place...
dialog.translation:
Hemos estado luchando por
encontrar cosas de nosotros
que ya teníamos de siempre...

dialog.english: So, what happened to this world?
dialog.translation:
Y qué pasó con este
mundo?

dialog.english: So, what happened to this world?
dialog.translation:
Y qué pasó con este
mundo?

dialog.english:
The Dark Masters found out about
our plan, and decided to get in
our way.
dialog.translation:
Los Amos Oscuros descubrieron
el plan y se interpusieron.

dialog.english: and decided to get in our way.
dialog.translation: y se interpusieron.

dialog.english:
They invaded and tried to steal
the Emblemas. He was the one who
protected them from Piemon...
dialog.translation:
Invadieron e intentaron robar
los Emblemas. Él fue quien
los protegió de Piedmon...

dialog.english: Ah! Could that be Gennai?!
dialog.translation: Ah! Podría ser Gennai?!

dialog.english:
He took the Emblemas and DigiEggs
and brought them to File Island.
dialog.translation:
Se llevó los Emblemas y
DigiHuevos, y los trajo a la
Isla File.

dialog.english:
Unfortunately, due to the
interference of his pursuers, he
lost track of one of them.
dialog.translation:
Por desgracia, por la
interferencia de sus
perseguidores, perdió uno.

dialog.english: he lost track of one of them.
dialog.translation: perdió uno de ellos.

dialog.english: he lost track of one of them.
dialog.translation: perdió uno de ellos.

dialog.english:
That was when my DigiEgg got
separated from the others...
dialog.translation:
Fue entonces cuando mi
DigiHuevo se separó del
resto...

dialog.english: And a long, long time passed.
dialog.translation: Y pasó muchísimo tiempo.

dialog.english:
I remember. I was always
waiting... for Tai!
dialog.translation:
Lo recuerdo. Siempre estuve
esperando... a Tai!

dialog.english: For Matt!
dialog.translation: A Matt!

dialog.english: For Sora!
dialog.translation: A Sora!

dialog.english: For Joe!
dialog.translation: A Joe!

dialog.english: For Mimi!
dialog.translation: A Mimi!

dialog.english: For T.K!
dialog.translation: A T.K!

dialog.english: For Izzy!
dialog.translation: A Izzy!

dialog.english: For Izzy!
dialog.translation: A Izzy!

dialog.english:
The days passed, and then one
day... I met Tai.
dialog.translation:
Los días pasaron, y un
día... conocí a Tai.

dialog.english:
So that's why. And what are we
supposed to do now?
dialog.translation:
Así que es por eso. Y ahora
qué hacemos?

dialog.english: Right now, even we don't know...
dialog.translation:
Ni nosotros lo sabemos
ahora...

dialog.english:
But I believe that you can figure
that out with your own abilities.
dialog.translation:
Pero creo que podéis
averiguarlo con vuestras
propias fuerzas.

dialog.english: U-Ugh...
dialog.translation: U-ugh...

dialog.english: Kari...
dialog.translation: Kari...

dialog.english: Tai...
dialog.translation: Tai...

dialog.english: Thank goodness!
dialog.translation: Menos mal!

dialog.english:
Kari... About what happened
earlier...
dialog.translation:
Kari... sobre lo que ha
pasado antes...

dialog.english: What happened earlier?
dialog.translation: Qué ha pasado antes?

dialog.english:
Never mind. It's fine if you don't
remember.
dialog.translation:
Da igual. No pasa nada si
no te acuerdas.

dialog.english:
Matt. So now you know why we're
the Chosen Children, right?
dialog.translation:
Matt. Entonces ya sabes por
qué somos los Niños Elegidos?

dialog.english: Yeah.
dialog.translation: Sí.

dialog.english:
We're the only ones who can fix 
the distortion in this world. So 
let's work together again!
dialog.translation:
Solo nosotros podemos arreglar
la distorsión de este mundo.
Trabajemos juntos otra vez!

dialog.english: Sorry.
dialog.translation: Perdón

dialog.english: Matt!
dialog.translation: Matt!

dialog.english: Was I wrong?
dialog.translation: Estaba mal?

dialog.english: No, all of it was my fault.
dialog.translation: No, todo fue culpa mía.

dialog.english:
I don't know why I fought you. I
thought I'd be able to find my own
way of life if I did...
dialog.translation:
No sé por qué luché contigo.
Pensé que así encontraría mi
propio camino...

dialog.english:
I don't think you'll be able to
forgive me with just an apology,
but I'm sorry.
dialog.translation:
No creo que puedas perdonarme
solo con una disculpa, pero lo
siento.

dialog.english: Matt...
dialog.translation: Matt...

dialog.english:
But I want to find my own way. No,
I *have* to find it.
dialog.translation:
Quiero encontrar mi camino.
Tengo que encontrarlo.

dialog.english:
So I'm going to leave and work on
my own. Just me and Tsunomon.
dialog.translation:
Así que me voy a ir a
trabajar solo. Solo yo y
Tsunomon.

dialog.english:
Hey, how about this? We can split
into two groups and work from
there.
dialog.translation:
Oye, qué tal esto? Podemos
dividirnos en dos grupos y
seguir así.

dialog.english:
Sorry... but I have to do this by
myself.
dialog.translation:
Lo siento, pero tengo que
hacerlo solo.

dialog.english:
Okay. But I believe you'll be
fine, Matt.
dialog.translation:
Vale. Pero sé que estarás
bien, Matt.

dialog.english:
Matt... What am I supposed to
do...?
dialog.translation:
Matt... qué se supone que
haga yo...?

dialog.english:
You'll be fine by yourself,
T.K.
dialog.translation:
Tú vas a estar bien solo,
T.K.

dialog.english:
T.K, Matt wants to think over
some stuff by himself. Let him go.
dialog.translation:
T.K, Matt quiere pensar en
unas cosas él solo. Déjale ir.

dialog.english: Okay...
dialog.translation: Vale...

dialog.english: Thanks. All right, see you.
dialog.translation: Gracias. Nos vemos.

dialog.english:
All right, now we need to get
going.
dialog.translation:
Bien, hay que ponerse en
marcha.

dialog.english: Huh? Mimi?
dialog.translation: Eh? Mimi?

dialog.english: Sorry, Sora... I can't go.
dialog.translation: Perdona, Sora, no puedo ir

dialog.english:
You're not coming? You want to
stay here?
dialog.translation:
No vienes? Quieres quedarte
aquí?

dialog.english:
Yeah. I... I don't want to see
anyone else get hurt.
dialog.translation:
Sí. Yo... no quiero ver a
nadie más salir herido.

dialog.english: I'll stay behind, too.
dialog.translation: Yo también me quedo.

dialog.english: Joe?
dialog.translation: Joe?

dialog.english:
It's dangerous for Mimi to be here
by herself... I'll try to persuade
her. Is that okay?
dialog.translation:
Es peligroso que Mimi se
quede sola aquí... intentaré
convencerla. Te parece bien?

dialog.english:
All right. We're counting on you,
Joe!
dialog.translation:
Vale. Contamos contigo,
Joe!

dialog.english:
And we just got all eight of them
together...
dialog.translation:
Y justo acabábamos de
reunir a los ocho...

dialog.english: You don't understand, do you?
dialog.translation: No lo entiendes, verdad?

dialog.english: Huh?
dialog.translation: Qué?

dialog.english:
The roads we take are different,
but our destination is the same,
even with some thorns in the road.
dialog.translation:
Los caminos que tomamos son
distintos, pero el destino es
el mismo, aunque haya espinas.

dialog.english:
It's for T.K's sake, too... I
can't just leave myself like
this...
dialog.translation:
Es también por T.K... no
puedo quedarme así como
estoy...

dialog.english: We have to find Matt...
dialog.translation: Busquemos a Matt...
